entities.name: Merle Jääger
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Merle Jääger is an Estonian television, stage and film actress, poet and author who frequently uses the pen name Merca. Initially associated with the burgeoning Estonian punk rock scene of the early to mid 1980s, she has been described as the "bard of protest". Her career as an actress began in her early 20s and she has received a number of high-profile awards for stage roles. Merle Jääger was a poets & playwrights from Tallinn (b. 1965-10-19, Tallinn).
